verdict.rationale: Working Copy has its own event-driven automation: Auto-Sync commits, pulls and pushes whenever changes are detected, and Background Sync keeps this running while you use other apps. However, this is a fixed toggle, not user-definable rules. Its Shortcuts and x-callback-url support exposes actions to automate, but event triggers there come from the host Shortcuts app, not the product. Missing for 10: user-defined rule or condition authoring, a choice of trigger events (e.g., on push or pull), configurable actions per event, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
